% A book with sectsty's own part fonts, set with its one-argument
% \partfont, \parttitlefont, and \partnumberfont, a sans-serif
% \allsectionsfont, and a chapter font in color.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{sectsty}
\allsectionsfont{\sffamily}
\partfont{\color{blue}\itshape}
\parttitlefont{\centering\bfseries}
\partnumberfont{\raggedleft}
\chapterfont{\color{red}}
\input{test-sectpart-cases.ltx}
